SELECT m.*, a.area_name AS area_name, u1.user_name AS manager_name, os.name AS operation_status_name, IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT u2.user_name), '') AS staffs_name_str, IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT gt.name), '') AS garbage_types_name_str, v.license_plate AS vehicle_name, u3.user_name AS check_name, hs.name AS handle_status_name, cr.check_result_name AS check_result_name, tt.name AS task_type_name FROM market m LEFT JOIN sys_area a ON m.area_code = a.area_code AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_operation_status os ON m.operation_status_id = os.sys_operation_status_id AND os.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON m.manager_id = u1.user_id AND u1.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON FIND_IN_SET( u2.user_id, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(m.staff_ids, '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', ''), ' ', '') ) AND u2.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_garbage_type gt ON FIND_IN_SET( gt.sys_garbage_type_id, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(m.garbage_type_ids, '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', ''), ' ', '') ) AND gt.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_vehicle v ON m.vehicle_id = v.sys_vehicle_id AND v.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u3 ON m.check_by = u3.user_id AND u3.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_handle_status hs ON m.handle_status_id = hs.sys_handle_status_id AND hs.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_check_result cr ON m.check_result_id = cr.check_result_id AND cr.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_task_type tt ON m.task_type_id = tt.sys_task_type_id AND tt.deleted = 0
GROUP BY m.id, a.area_name, os.name, u1.user_name, v.license_plate, u3.user_name, hs.name, cr.check_result_name, tt.name
ORDER BY m.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) FROM market m LEFT JOIN sys_area a ON m.area_code = a.area_code AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_operation_status os ON m.operation_status_id = os.sys_operation_status_id AND os.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON m.manager_id = u1.user_id AND u1.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON FIND_IN_SET( u2.user_id, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(m.staff_ids, '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', ''), ' ', '') ) AND u2.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_garbage_type gt ON FIND_IN_SET( gt.sys_garbage_type_id, REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(m.garbage_type_ids, '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', ''), ' ', '') ) AND gt.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_vehicle v ON m.vehicle_id = v.sys_vehicle_id AND v.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u3 ON m.check_by = u3.user_id AND u3.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_handle_status hs ON m.handle_status_id = hs.sys_handle_status_id AND hs.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_check_result cr ON m.check_result_id = cr.check_result_id AND cr.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_task_type tt ON m.task_type_id = tt.sys_task_type_id AND tt.deleted = 0
